Anarchist.Description: You believe power is corrupt and favor voluntary, non-hierarchical organizations based on direct democracy.

Argonaut.Description: You seek technoprogressive solutions to transhumanity’s injustices and inequalities.

Barsoomian.Description: You wish to see Mars liberated from hypercorp control.

Brinker.Description: You belong to a cult, commune, or other group that seeks isolation from the rest of transhumanity.

Criminal.Description: You are associated with the underworld, either part of a large cartel, smaller gang, or as an independent operator.

Extropian.Description: You believe in unrestricted free markets and that taking proactive risks with technology is better than playing it safe.

Hypercorp.Description: You support hypercapitalist expansion and competitive-economics-driven social order. You accept that certain liberties must be restricted for security and freedom.

Jovian.Description: You are a bioconservative concerned about out-of-control transhuman technologies.

Lunar/Orbital.Description: You support the conservative economics, Earth-tied nationalism, and traditionalism of the Lunar-Lagrange Alliance.

Mercurial.Description: You oppose the assimilation and oppression of AGIs and uplifts, supporting self-determination for your kind.

Reclaimer.Description: You believe transhumanity should be focused on reclaiming, terraforming, and repopulating Earth.

Scum.Description: You push the boundaries of the experimental, fully testing what it means to be transhuman.

Socialite.Description: You are a part of the glitterati, defining and defined by inner-system media culture.

Titanian.Description: You are a technosocialist, believing that science and technology can provide for the well-being of all.

Venusian.Description: You adhere to the Morningstar Constellation’s vision for a more socialized, friendlier hypercapitalism.

Solarian.Description: You are invested in the culture, prosperity, and security of the inner Solar System's core habitats and planets.

Sifter.Description: You belong to the Sifters, skilled salvagers and scavengers who thrive in the debris fields and ruins across the Solar System.

Belter.Description: You are a resident of the asteroid belt, focused on mining, trade, and independence from inner system control.

Europan.Description: You hail from Europa or its habitats, dedicated to advancing life and society in the harsh Jovian environs.

Ringer.Description: You live in the rings of Saturn, forming close-knit communities among the floating habitats and resource nodes.

Skimmer.Description: You are part of the scattered communities skimming the outer Solar System, adaptable and resilient in the frontier.
